caption:
Revenge trading is the urge to win a loss back right now, with bigger size and no real setup.
In this example, one $50 loss turns into $350 after two angry trades at double, then quadruple, the size.
Set a daily stop before you start: after two losses, or a set amount, you're done for the day. The market will still be there tomorrow.
Be honest: have you ever tried to win it back right away? Yes or no.

Education only. Not financial advice.
